title: Structured registration validation
difficulty_rationale: Many interacting rules (8 error codes across 6 fields), deterministic error ordering, collect-all semantics and strict type handling (bool is not int) must all match the specification.
summary: Implement validate_registration() returning all field errors as structured (field, code) pairs in a deterministic order.
required_behavior: Return ValidationResult(ok, errors, cleaned) where errors is a list of FieldError(field, code).
All errors are collected (not only the first) and ordered by FIELD_ORDER, then by the rule order defined in the prompt.
Each field produces at most one error code.
Unknown keys produce FieldError(<key>, 'unknown_field') after all known-field errors, sorted by key.
cleaned contains normalized values (username lower-cased and stripped, email stripped and lower-cased) only when ok is True; otherwise it is an empty dict.
acceptance_criteria: Dataclass definitions and FIELD_ORDER remain unchanged.

acceptance_tests.description: A valid payload yields ok=True and normalized cleaned data.
Type and range rules for age, bool rejected.
Errors from all fields in FIELD_ORDER order.
Unknown keys reported after known fields, sorted.
